public_rationale: Under the stated reading about subscription assurances, both providers reserve the ability to change their services. Anthropic explicitly includes capacity reductions. OpenAI's notice provision does not promise three months of unchanged workload support. This supports the claim about assurance at purchase; it does not establish that workflows actually failed three months later.
limitations: The result depends on reading clarity as reliable subscription assurance, rather than every user's subjective confidence.
Standard terms do not establish the position under separately negotiated agreements.
Permission to change a service is not proof that a harmful change occurred.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant standard subscriptions provide enforceable three-month assurances of the capacity and functionality needed to continue existing workloads.
